games.kernel-bunker:
Two teams face off on the grounds of an abandoned bunker where strange things are happening: a mysterious black sun is changing the laws of physics.

Every detail of the setting is carefully crafted for full immersion: the atmosphere of the past, realistic weapons and paranormal phenomena. Communication and team strategy make the difference.
games.kernel-raven:
Rival teams meet on the construction site of the Another World corporation's skyscraper. A vast map with plenty of cover and tactical options, for those who want to put their strategy to the test.

Realistic graphics and a high level of detail make every round feel like a real mission.
games.kernel-survival-protocol:
Your team has tough objectives to complete in a place where every corner may hide a threat. The tense atmosphere and terrifying enemies keep you on edge until the very end.

Recommended for those looking for an intense experience.
games.shmooter-cubes:
A virtual world built from cubes: snowy mountains, forests, houses and airships. Teams compete in high-energy battles with friendly graphics.

Great for mixed groups, where everyone finds a role.
games.shmooter-forts:
Step into a colourful virtual world full of epic team battles. Capture the base, destroy buildings, jump between platforms and use the bus as cover.

Accuracy and reflexes matter — and so does how well you coordinate.
games.shmooter-island-assault:
Weapons and armour are hidden all over the island. Your team has to find them fast and defend the island from invaders.

A bright action adventure, also suitable for younger players.
games.shmooter-skyscrapers:
Battle your friends in every-player-for-themselves or team vs team mode. Collect power-ups to get stronger, catch your opponents by surprise and train your accuracy and reflexes.

The cartoon-style graphics make the game accessible and fun.
games.shmooter-space-battle:
Endless space, cold and distant stars — and a space station under attack by alien invaders. Your team has to defend it, side by side.

A colourful, high-energy sci-fi battle.
games.shmooter-space-battle-2:
The battles continue on the space station. This time there's a new weapon in your arsenal, and teleporters take you to other floors of the station.

Fight every player for themselves or team vs team — and try not to fly off into outer space.
games.ghost-tower-conacul-fantomelor:
A group of ghost hunters arrives at an abandoned mansion. Otherworldly creatures have taken over the house, and the team has to free it using a special magic weapon.

Careful: the ghosts are sneaky! An adventure designed for children.
games.ghost-tower-dance:
In an abandoned mansion full of adorable ghosts, the party is on! Pick the music, copy the characters' moves and compete with your friends for the most points.

The funny ghosts become your audience.
games.ghost-tower-fishing:
A game for children in which players try to catch as many colourful fish as they can. Friendly competition, helpful ghosts, simple controls and cheerful graphics.

Perfect for young adventurers.
games.mysterious-tower-miners:
Choose your avatars, grab your pickaxes and head into the mine. Collect crystals, score points and become legends of the mine.

A team adventure with simple rules.
games.safe-night:
After a radioactive disaster, the survivors have turned into mutants. Your team has to hold out until the evacuation arrives.

Tension, cooperation and quick decisions.
games.starbase-expedition:
Colonists arrive at a space station on planet Alekta, at the edge of explored space. What they find there is the beginning of a nightmare.

A sci-fi mission in which the team has to work together to solve the mystery of the station.
games.starbase-survival: The team is stranded on a platform surrounded by dangerous life forms that have evolved in unexpected ways. Survival depends on how well you coordinate.
games.taverna:
Elves, wizards, knights and other fantasy guests are waiting to be served. Your team takes over the tavern and has to work in sync: prepare the orders, serve them and keep up the pace.

A co-op game with no weapons, great for mixed groups.
games.colony-code-red:
Humanity is colonising space. Crews sleep in cryogenic capsules while artificial intelligence pilots the ships to distant colonies.

You are the crew of the colony ship Vega, sent to replace the colonists on planet Alekta. What could possibly go wrong?
